US Imposes Tariffs on Indian Goods Amid Forced Labour Concerns

The US has imposed a 10% tariff on Indian goods amid concerns over forced labour practices. The move is part of the US's efforts to investigate and prevent the importation of goods made using forced labour. This development may have implications for India's trade agreements and exports.
